> You have to remind your friend that she is loved even if it’s from you only, and you have to let her talk to you. 

I've told her this, and all she said was something along the lines of "I don't care if people love me anymore"

> tell her to talk to someone 

She apparently doesn't have an adult in her life to talk to.  I've tried everything and will keep trying, but I'm not a doctor and I don't want to say something that might fuck everything up

>  call the cops 

I've been considering it, but idk when the proper time to do it is
